sets.name: Tactile/Spinner
sets.note: existing Actions set reused (LED segments, tone axis)

swapTest: 5/5 pass (Alert title+description+action+close, Inline notice description+close, Toast title+description+progress, Progress label+value+track padding, Empty state title+secondaryAction)
bindings: tactile/* colour roles only (generic core->tactile remap; the only unmapped role, table/row-bg at 0% on the preset root, was cleared); effects are the named Tactile/* styles
anatomy: Alert: printed (H0) so it nests inside plateaus (sign-in card, sheet, dialog): flat tactile/surface/well band at radius/card, no stroke or effect. Status = a lit 8px LED (led/<tone> + Tactile/led-glow/<tone>) centred in the label-line icon box (glyph kept hidden) + the word in text/strong; body text/body. strong (derived): title in the status ink and the base rule drawn as the 4px LED edge.
Inline notice: printed surface/well band r14 with a 7px LED + word.

Toast: a floating Tc.plateau (surface/base, edge/border, Tactile/plateau, radius/card); LED + word; default keeps its printed glyph, loading Tactile/Spinner; timer = 6px meter (slider rail fill + well-s, text/body fill) inset, theme-only timer-gap; actions Tactile keys.
Progress: meter (as 144:1800): pill well track (rail fill + Tactile/well-s), 6/8/10 tall; printed ink fill (primary text/body, secondary text/muted, status text/<tone>); value still = track padding.
Progress circular: LED gauge: track led/off, arc lit led/<tone> + glow, Spinner dash pattern.
Skeleton: each bone a small sunk well (rail concave fill + Tactile/well-s); pill lines, round avatars, r14 blocks (lg r20).
Skeleton preset: table = printed r20 tiles without rules; stats = plateaus; detail/form = surface/well bands r14.
Empty state: border on = printed surface/well band r20 (no lines); media a surface/tone disc with the glyph in text/body | text/muted | text/danger; actions Tactile keys.

sweep.detail: Data display 1: 67 Skeleton + 2 Empty state (Tactile/Table, Tactile/Data table)

defectsFixed: Sheet scrim opaque (tactile/surface/well = VariableID:119:743 at 100%): backdrop/scrim paints set to 60% on Tactile/Sheet (4 scrim variants), and the same defect on Tactile/Drawer (4), Tactile/Dialog (3) and Tactile/Command palette (3).
Toggle group showed '12' on every option: the theme-only count boolean on Tactile/Toggle / sm, md and lg now defaults to false (no explicit count=true overrides remain in Tactile sets).

Taller controls overflow the Sheet: in the fixed-height side=left/right variants (scrim on and off) the body now fills the panel (layoutGrow 1) and clips, so taller Tactile content scrolls inside the body instead of running past the footer; top/bottom sheets hug their content.

Owner note 2026-10-31 (row tones, 'check the others'): Tactile/Table rows were all success; tone and label re-applied from the base Table (Paid success, Awaiting payment warning, Shipped info, Paid success, Refunded neutral); Tactile/Data table inherits. Screen tables already had correct per-row overrides.
